description: This PHP source file defines the class 'GenericBasicDisplayField' which extends 'BasicDisplayField'. It maps a set of predefined display field aliases to entity and field names used within HRM reporting, providing methods to set display fields and retrieve their entity and field identifiers.

classes.name: GenericBasicDisplayField
classes.description: A class representing a basic display field in HRM reports, mapping field aliases to entity and field names.

methods.name: setDisplayField
methods.description: Sets the display field based on the provided display field object by mapping its alias to entity and field names.

methods.name: getEntityAlias
methods.description: Returns the entity alias associated with this display field.

methods.name: setEntityAlias
methods.description: Assigns the entity alias for this display field.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Returns the field name associated with this display field.

methods.name: setField
methods.description: Assigns the field name for this display field.
